8.text: Along with all these acquisitions were also brought contagious diseases,

9.text: alcohol, and card-playing, and their influence certainly equals that of the newly

10.text: introduced inventions. I will repeat once more the words of Kuvaˊr, the Eskimo

11.text: trader at Indian Point (see p. 36), in reference to this very circumstance: “The

12.text: spirits, it seems, take care that the people of this country shall not multiply.

13.text: In olden times war was sent down to ward off increase. After that, in spite

14.text: of the abundant variety of sea-game, famine would come and carry off the

15.text: surplus. At present, with the fulsome supply of American food, the disease

16.text: comes down, and the result is exactly the same.”
